links.outcome: GPT-4V accuracy on board certification exam questions across prompt and input types
links.effect: Accuracy for text-only input averaged 24.7%, improving to 47.3% with English translation and prompts (P<.001); nonresponse rate 46.3% fell to 2.7%.
links.quote: The accuracy rate for text-only input was, on average, 24.7% but improved to 47.3% with the addition of English translation and prompts (P<.001).

unlisted_practices: Adding English translation and prompt engineering to improve LLM accuracy on non-English (Japanese) exam questions
Supplying images alongside text to improve multimodal model accuracy on image-based questions

screen.reason: The study is a medical exam benchmark evaluating GPT-4V accuracy on Japanese otolaryngology board certification questions using different prompt variations and translations.
